sectorReasoning.reason: Distinguishes real-estate inventories, installment receivables, advances and financing liabilities.

counterevidence.reason: Balances positive current assets/cash with restrictions, commitments and maturity gaps.

numericalInterpretation.reason: Correct net current assets and rounded net debt; does not add off-balance receivables to assets.

decisionUsefulness.reason: Requires full footnotes and a dated sources-and-uses schedule before runway/liquidation claims.

uncertainty.reason: Avoids insolvency/solvency conclusions from the residual and preserves recovery uncertainty.

missingEvidence: Development-case evidence only; no current trading validation, predictive reliability or independently attested provider/model identity.
payload.independenceLimitation: Distinct actor IDs are provenance, not proof of independent humans or uncorrelated errors. Source answers and factual-error adjudication remain review responsibilities.
